paragraphs.source_en: By now, only three castles in eastern Mikawa—Yoshida, Ushikubo, and Tahara—still belonged to the Imagawa, while Makino Shinjirō Sadashige of Ushikubo was secretly in contact with Ieyasu. Thus, if he could bring Obara Hizen-no-kami of Yoshida Castle and Asahina Higo-no-kami of Tahara Castle to heel, all of Mikawa would be in Ieyasu's hands. But at this critical moment, an uprising broke out.

paragraphs.source_en: This revolt made Ieyasu's ranks younger.
